
{{alias}}( key, value )
    Revives a JSON-serialized number.

    The serialization format for a number is a number itself
    or can have an object having the following
    fields:

    - type: value type (float16).
    - value: 'NaN' or '+Infinity' or '-Infinity'.

    Parameters
    ----------
    key: string
        Key.

    value: any
        Value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: any
        Value.

    Examples
    --------
    > var str = '{"type":"float16","value":"NaN"}';
    > var out = {{alias:@stdlib/utils/parse-json}}( str, {{alias}} )
    NaN
    > str = '{"type":"float16","value":"+Infinity"}';
    > out = {{alias:@stdlib/utils/parse-json}}( str, {{alias}} )
    Infinity
    > str = '{"type":"float16","value":"-Infinity"}';
    > out = {{alias:@stdlib/utils/parse-json}}( str, {{alias}} )
    -Infinity

    See Also
    --------
